purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S2_offfloor_mechanisms. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md. NOT RUNNABLE (HOLD): see not_runnable_reason.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: HOLD: Frozen register (register-rev2-frozen-20261010T1833Z) section 3: this stage plan holds entries the register keeps out (S2-05, S2-07, and the FNORD duplicates S2-09, S2-10) and starts with S2-01, not S2-11 (S2 order: S2-11 first). The register route is campaign_C10_DIAGa_S2-11, then campaign_C10_DIAG. A kept-out entry needs a logged register amendment and its own plan labelled exploratory.
A NOMINAL or SRH null test producing floor-scale current contradicts the CALCULATED bounds: stop, audit KCL / CR.TOLER / deck, do not fit.
Floor-scale current from the WORST-case oxide set is an allowed result; interpret it only after S2-11 (oxide mesh x0.5) agrees within 0.1 dec in log10 I_G.
Strip decks (S2-14..17) must give I(0.7 V)/I(0.1 V) = 7.0 +- 0.5; otherwise the strip is not ohmic in ATLAS and that is the result.
Verdicts by the pre-registered rule of CAMPAIGN_DESIGN 7.2 (valid points >= 80 %, |d_floor_ratio| <= 0.5 dec, |slope| <= 2|measured| + 2 sigma, KCL); a 2 nm underprediction does not falsify.

S2-12/S2-13 (QTNLSC + oxide TAT, trap charge out of Poisson): post_run_checks.py needs --gate-control S2-04 (2.0 nm) / S2-06 (13.2 nm) to identify ITAT separately; the charged-oxide electrostatics are not tested by these runs.
S2-09/S2-10 (FNORD): F.AE/F.BE are the HfO2-barrier constants transferred to the Al2O3/IWO-segment field (A/r^2, r B, r = 2.1744); still a single-barrier approximation.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans

runs.label: c10_s2_01_13p2
overrides: solver.models=fermi srh temp=300 print trap.tunnel trap.hurkx mass.tunnel=0.2123
runs.purpose: SRH/TAT null test at 13.2 nm: two carriers, background lifetime 1e-9 s and capture cross-sections x100 (1e-13 cm2) - both beyond the reasonable range - plus field-enhanced trap capture (TRAP.TUNNEL, TRAP.HURKX, MASS.TUNNEL = DFT m*(t)). Upper bound on generation current inside the solver.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_D(off) - I_D(off, S1-06 or S0-01) <= 1e-20 A/um (COMPUTED bound <= 8e-29 A/um x 1e3 enhancement); floor ratio <= 1e-5. A floor-scale current would contradict the bound -> numerics audit, not a fit.

runs.purpose: SRH-off reference at 13.2 nm (two carriers): SRH flag removed and all DEFECTS capture cross-sections x1e-5 (occupancy is unchanged because it depends on the ratio of capture rates). Isolates the recombination term.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_D identical to S1-06 within 1e-3 relative above 1e-14 A/um

runs.label: c10_s2_11_2p0
runs.purpose: Numerics of the leakage result (register H-C, S2-11 redefined; first S2 launch): S0-02 (run_0067 form: QTNLSC worst set, automatic slicing, S/D exclude_near) with the device oxide y-mesh spacing halved at the oxide lines (Al2O3 line 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, HfO2 line 1.0 -> 0.5 nm); the y = 0 IWO/Al2O3 line (0.0625 nm, shared with the IWO interface mesh) is unchanged. Actual refinement (run_0067 equilibrium.str + geometric grading): Al2O3 15 -> about 22 intervals (largest 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, smallest 0.06 nm unchanged), HfO2 28 -> about 55, i.e. Al2O3 about x1.5 and HfO2 about x2. Timeout x4.5: run_0067 took 1246 s on 9594 nodes and 43 oxide intervals per slice; this deck has about 13.7k nodes and about 77 (run_0062, 13,689 nodes and 75, ran out of memory at the old 2 GB limit).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: resolved log10 |I_G| changes by <= 0.1 dec at every V_G vs S0-02 (run_0067); points below the demonstrated resolution are censored, never a pass (register section 0 and H-C; score_register.py hc_mesh)

runs.label: c10_s2_12_2p0
runs.purpose: Defect-assisted gate leakage (Ielmini TAT, ITAT.SC.EL with DOPING TAT.TRAP in HfO2) at 2.0 nm: ASSUMED 1e19 cm-3 traps 1.0 eV below the HfO2 band edge, nominal oxide set, trap charge OUT of Poisson (MODELS ^tat.poisson, PDF p.323): at full occupancy the traps would carry 1.5e13 cm-2, far above the fitted Q_f, and the change in I_D would mix an electrostatic shift with collected leakage (2026-10-10 review fix). Matched gate control: S2-04 (2.0 nm) / S2-06 (13.2 nm). Tests the leakage path Codex could not exclude without I_G (Poole-Frenkel-like magnitudes). Syntax VERIFIED (PDF p.320-327, quantumex20), bilayer use UNVERIFIED. The charged-oxide electrostatics are NOT tested by this run.
runs.pre_registered_expectation: I_G strongly V_G-dependent (Codex PF estimate J(3.7 V)/J(1.2 V) ~ 6e3); flat-floor criterion not met
